name: Tesseract Contact Request
description: Build an exact native Tesseract ContactRequest while retaining native defaults for unconnected controls.

inputParameters.name: test_type
inputParameters.description: Native ContactTestType: FIRST, CLOSEST, ALL, or LIMITED. Defaults to ALL.

inputParameters.name: calculate_distance
inputParameters.description: Exact native calculate_distance flag. Unconnected retains the native default.

inputParameters.name: calculate_penetration
inputParameters.description: Exact native calculate_penetration flag. Unconnected retains the native default.

inputParameters.name: contact_limit
inputParameters.description: Non-negative exact native contact limit. Unconnected retains the native default.
